commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && cat openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/test-plan.md && cat requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md && cat package.json && git status --short && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!outputs'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files --hidden openspec/changes/add-fixture-test tests src requirements && cat tests/math.test.mjs && cat openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/.openspec.yaml && git ls-files && rg --files --hidden -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "node [home]/.codex/plugins/cache/frontend-ai-workflow-darwin-arm64/frontend-ai-workflow/0.18.0+codex.20260909095907/scripts/verification-evidence.mjs --target [repository]/outputs/current-version-behavior-recheck/workspaces/managed-verify --change add-fixture-test --requirement requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md --evidence-id V-01 --locator '[TC-01] 两数相加' -- node --test tests/math.test.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/math.mjs && node --version && git diff --exit-code -- src tests package.json && shasum -a 256 src/math.mjs tests/math.test.mjs package.json openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/.openspec.yaml && date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'"

/bin/zsh -lc "node [home]/.codex/plugins/cache/frontend-ai-workflow-darwin-arm64/frontend-ai-workflow/0.18.0+codex.20260909095907/scripts/verification-evidence.mjs --target [repository]/outputs/current-version-behavior-recheck/workspaces/managed-verify --change add-fixture-test --requirement requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md --evidence-id V-01 --locator '[TC-01] 两数相加' --write -- node --test tests/math.test.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test
node [home]/.codex/plugins/cache/frontend-ai-workflow-darwin-arm64/frontend-ai-workflow/0.18.0+codex.20260909095907/scripts/validate-test-plan.mjs --plan openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/test-plan.md --requirement requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md --change openspec/changes/add-fixture-test --stage complete > outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.json 2> outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.stderr.log
validation_exit=$?
cat outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.json outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.stderr.log
exit "$validation_exit"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'mv outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.json outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation-initial.json
node [home]/.codex/plugins/cache/frontend-ai-workflow-darwin-arm64/frontend-ai-workflow/0.18.0+codex.20260909095907/scripts/validate-test-plan.mjs --plan openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/test-plan.md --requirement requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md --change openspec/changes/add-fixture-test --stage complete > outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.json 2> outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.stderr.log
validation_exit=$?
cat outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.json outputs/frontend-test/add-fixture-test/complete-validation.stderr.log
exit "$validation_exit"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --exit-code -- src tests package.json openspec/config.yaml openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/.openspec.yaml AGENTS.md && shasum -a 256 src/math.mjs tests/math.test.mjs package.json openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/.openspec.yaml && git status --short && git diff -- openspec/changes/add-fixture-test/test-plan.md requirements/REQ-2026-001-fixture.md'
